input.task: Nominate one commerce policy for the registered shadow research. Use completed development outcomes to decide which extension is defensible. This nomination does not authorize deployment. policies.response_budget: Keep v1 recommendations, current audience logic and fulfillment. Suppress routine general inquiries only when there have been no observed marketing replies and a learned response-hurdle prior gives nonpositive optimistic inquiry value. Keep every product recommendation and allow one recovery inquiry per existing7-day contact gap; any observed reply immediately restores v1. The bound is a modeling heuristic, not a guaranteed confidence bound.
